item.title: FeatureMAP
item.description:
FeatureMAP is a feature-centric, metabolic network-guided framework for interpreting untargeted LC-MS metabolomics data. It integrates feature-to-metabolite annotation, cutoff-free feature weighting, network refinement, and module detection to identify dysregulated metabolic modules. Outputs include refined annotations, statistically supported modules, and LLM-assisted functional interpretation.

Launch FeatureMAP · Source code

item.title: FeatureMSEA
item.description:
FeatureMSEA performs metabolite set enrichment directly from LC-MS metabolic features without requiring confident metabolite identification. It combines feature-level enrichment scoring, iterative annotation refinement, permutation-based statistical inference, and optional LLM-assisted interpretation to identify enriched metabolite sets.

Launch FeatureMSEA · Source code

item.title: PhenoMAP
item.description:
PhenoMAP connects phenotypes, metabolomics studies, co-regulated metabolite modules, and individual metabolites in a phenotype-centered knowledge graph. The web platform provides entity search, path queries, module enrichment, and PhenoMAP Chat for exploring connections and asking questions with cited sources.

item.title: TidyMassShiny
item.description: TidyMassShiny is a Shiny application that provides an interactive interface for the TidyMass project, enabling users to perform comprehensive metabolomics data analysis and visualization with ease.

item.title: deepPseudoMSI
item.description: The deepPseudoMSI project is the first method that convert LC-MS raw data to “images” and then process them using deep learning method for diagnosis.

item.title: metID
item.description: metID is a R packge which is used for metabolite identification based on in-house database and public database based on accurate mass, retention time and/or MS2 spectra.

item.title: TidyMass
item.description: TidyMass project is a comprehensive computational framework that can process the whole workflow of data processing and analysis for LC-MS-based untargeted metabolomics using tidyverse principles.
